'''AC-08''' was an automated tour guide [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was employed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] prior to the [[destruction of Taris]]. It was later recovered from Taris's ruins around the [[Time/Legends|time]] when the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] controlled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
AC-08 first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the droid is a Companion Gift.
